name: worldforge
description: Worldforge — solo procedural hex-crawl vertical slice (Elm client, TypeScript server, PostgreSQL).

scripts.setup: cd server && npm install && cd ../client && npm install
scripts.build: npm run build:server && npm run build:client
scripts.build:client: cd client && npx elm make src/Main.elm --output=public/main.js
scripts.dev: npm run db:up && npm run build && cd server && npm run start
scripts.dev:memory: npm run build && cd server && WORLDFORGE_STORE=memory npm run start
scripts.test: npm run test:server && npm run test:contracts && npm run test:client && npm run test:e2e
scripts.test:contracts: cd server && npm run build && node --test "dist/test/contracts/*.test.js"
scripts.test:client: cd client && npx elm make src/Main.elm --output=/tmp/worldforge-client-check.js && npx elm-test
scripts.format:check: cd server && npm run format:check && cd ../client && npm run format:check
scripts.format:write: cd server && npm run format:write && cd ../client && npm run format:write
scripts.lint: cd server && npm run lint && cd ../client && npx elm make src/Main.elm --output=/dev/null
